BiblicalUsage: Shiphrah is the Hebrew midwife who fears God and will not kill the sons as Pharaoh commands. Because the midwives fear God, He deals well with them and builds them houses.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Shiphrah is one of the bravest women in the Bible, because she disobeys a king to obey God. I hold that the fear of God in a midwife's hands is worth more than Pharaoh's whole army.
